Problem Description
: FC2-3 tripped
Troubleshooting
: We have checked the charger and found these errors are active on the SCB. Please plan a site intervention to check the connections for the AC meter, and Power converters installed in the charger. Also please check if the FC2-3 MCB is also tripped. As I have analyzed from the logs, this error flag turns active everyday just once and didn't find error gets inactive.
We can see following error flag on SCB for this charger-
This means that MCB FC2 or FC3 is tripped
These fuses are used to provide 230V to dispenser.
You will need to do a site intervention to check whether any of these 2 fuses are trip or not, also carry spare fuses.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0393103
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Beerpal Singh
